subject: CAIQ: control ownership sprint and evidence return plan
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@brightlanehealth.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@brightlanehealth.com
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ follow-up + requested artifacts

Hi Aisha and team,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — BrightLane's InfoSec team has a handful of follow-ups as we prepare our vendor assessment. Attached is our current CAIQ spreadsheet (BrightLane_CAIQ_v3.xlsx) with highlighted controls where we need either: (a) a short narrative answer, or (b) evidence artifacts (logs, config screenshots, runbooks).

Top asks:
- P-IA-3 and P-IA-4: we need proof of key rotation cadence and HSM/KMS attestation.
- TSC-01: please confirm tenant isolation design and an example diagram or runbook.
- LOG-RET-02: sample retention policy and a small log extract showing retention metadata.

Can we schedule a 60-minute workshop with control owners to walk the spreadsheet and agree on delivery dates? Ideally next week — prefer Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Security Assurance Manager
BrightLane Health

Attachments: BrightLane_CAIQ_v3.xlsx (excel, 420KB)
From: aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, david.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 10:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up + requested artifacts

PRIYOM / DAVID — forwarding BrightLane's CAIQ with their highlights. Quick triage below and a proposed plan.

Summary of ask (quick):
- Narrative answers for ~20 controls, evidence for ~12 controls.
- Workshop to align owners and delivery dates.

Proposed sprint:
1) Internal kickoff today: map each highlighted CAIQ row to an owner (I started a roster).
2) Pre-workshop owner notes: owners add short answer + note whether evidence exists in our artifact store.
3) Workshop (60m) with BrightLane Tue 2026-11-10 10:00 PST (provisional) — we'll confirm.
4) Post-workshop 7-day delivery window for most artifacts; exceptions escalated to Eng/SRE.

I attached a CAIQ-evidence-index-template.xlsx — use it to capture where artifacts live (Drive link or ticket id). David: can you take the controls with infrastructure implications (TSC-01, LOG-RET-02, P-IA-3)? Priyom: can you own encryption/KMS narrative and KMS/HSM evidence collation. Neha: can you coordinate the legal/compliance narrative bits and manage the workshop invite + calendar.

A few immediate notes:
- For P-IA-3 (key rotation), we have a key rotation policy in Drive (kms/key-rotation.md) but need a short attestation and an export from KMS showing last rotation dates (Engineering).
- For tenant isolation, David — please prepare a 1-page diagram + a short runbook snippet that explains logical isolation and network controls.

I will reply to Marta with a proposed schedule and attach our template.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CAIQ-evidence-index-template.xlsx (excel, 24KB)

Copying status and owners below. I pulled a first-pass roster and attached a CSV.

Owner notes (initial):
- TSC-01 (tenant isolation): owner=David Kim (Infra). Deliverable: 1-page isolation diagram + runbook excerpt. Eng dependency: network team to confirm VPC peering rules (ticket NET-442).
- LOG-RET-02 (log retention): owner=Neha Kapoor (Observability). Deliverable: retention policy doc + sample log export metadata. Note: retention export will require a support window (we have a 48h SLA to pull historic indices).
- P-IA-3/P-IA-4 (key rotation / KMS attest): owner=Priyom Das (Security Platform). Deliverable: policy excerpt + KMS rotation export + HSM vendor attestation (where applicable). Engineering: may need HSM vendor contact for attestation PDF.
- Remaining narrative answers: split across Compliance team (Aisha) and Product (TBD).

Attached: control_owner_roster.csv (3KB) — I marked owners and initial ETA (most set to 2026-11-17).

I'll prepare the 1-page isolation diagram by Mon EOD and will add the runbook snippet to the Drive folder linked below.

-David

Hi Marta — thanks for the CAIQ and the clear highlights. We're aligned to run a control-owner workshop and to return artifacts per the timeline below.

Workshop: Tue 2026-11-10 10:00-11:00 PST (virtual) — calendar invite sent (link below). Agenda: walk highlighted CAIQ rows, confirm owners & delivery dates, note blockers.

Delivery plan (high level):
- Most artifacts: deliver by 2026-11-17 (7 days after workshop).
- KMS/HSM attestation and rotation exports: targeted 2026-11-19 (may require vendor attestation).
- Tenant isolation runbook + diagram: first draft 2026-11-09 (David), final by 2026-11-16 after infra review.

We created a Drive folder and a template for owners to populate (see links). Please confirm if the workshop time works or propose an alternate slot. If you want us to provide a short executive summary (1 page) as part of the package, we can include that in the post-workshop deliverables.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman

Redwood Inference
